objective: Look and feel pass after the first integration run: dusk lighting that reads as dusk, HUD icons, a clear turret view, visible small items, solo night balance, a Lampeater that feels like a finale, and the stop site centred on the train.
acceptance_criteria: Day stops read as dusk (teal-violet sky with a warm peach horizon, readable ground, warm lantern pools) and nights stay readable; screenshots judged against the art bible
20 Pillow-drawn icon decals uploaded and used by the HUD and panels through LanternIcons (glyph fallback kept)
At a lamp turret the player's own avatar never blocks the aim view
Small items are visible at 30 studs in grass (glow, outline or bob) without breaking the Mild look
A solo player with fair play reaches the Depot on leg 1 most nights; numbers pinned in TrainRules or WispRules specs and the pacing script
The Lampeater reads as a finale (size, entrance, wing flaps) and is reachable in a normal run
The stop site is centred on the middle of the train
verification: Director review of new screenshots; Studio solo runs with numbers; CI
notes: Created by the Director after reviewing the LANTERN-012 screenshots on 2026-11-07.
